title: Front driver corner
instruction: Stand at the front-left; capture the full front and driver side.

title: Front passenger corner
instruction: Stand at the front-right for a 3/4 view.

title: Rear driver corner
instruction: Stand at the rear-left for a 3/4 view.

title: Rear passenger corner
instruction: Stand at the rear-right for a 3/4 view.

title: Front
instruction: Full front view; license plate visible if possible.

title: Rear
instruction: Full rear view of the vehicle.

title: Driver side
instruction: Full profile along the driver side.

title: Passenger side
instruction: Full profile along the passenger side.

title: Dashboard / odometer
instruction: Dash on; odometer reading clearly visible.

title: Fuel / charge level
instruction: Fuel gauge or battery level visible.

title: Front seats
instruction: Wide shot of the front cabin.

title: Rear seats
instruction: Wide shot of the rear cabin.

title: Trunk / cargo
instruction: Trunk or hatch open; show the cargo area.

title: Tire
instruction: Close-up of one tire showing tread and sidewall.

title: VIN plate
instruction: VIN sticker on door jamb or windshield.
